transcript: Last night I attended the first preview of The Trees at Playwrights Horizons. In it, a pair of siblings are out in the forest one night and find themselves permanently rooted into the ground the next day. As they are initially shocked by the idea of these extraordinary circumstances being their new normal, over time the siblings find hope and community around them. With life having become so much more simple, the scope of their world shrinks and they learn who is truly there for them. The play was funny and quirky, yet resonant and in many ways allegorical. And with that, another program for my collection.
